data.narrative:
Deepnight is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of 10 peers—2 public companies and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage band, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $5.5M raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x, implying a valuation of $14M. Peer-Median anchors to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A). The median of these peers is $400M, establishing an upper-bound reference point.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $12M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $207M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Deepnight's competitive positioning and growth trajectory relative to peers. The low-end reflects its early capital raise; the high-end is anchored to peer medians in a sector showing significant valuation variance. Key uncertainties include the company's technical differentiation, revenue traction, and the sustainability of current Defense & Security valuations. Additional diligence on product-market fit and customer pipeline is warranted before narrowing this range.
